note: Per-platform native jars. Gradle plugin: vespera.nativeJarPlatforms packages one classifier jar per platform (nativeJar<Platform> tasks + nativeJars; e.g. myapp-native-0.1.0-linux-x86_64.jar holding only native/linux-x86_64/<lib>) from vespera.nativeJarsDir (default extraNativeLibs, e.g. CI-matrix artifacts) and, with maven-publish, publishes them as the classifier artifacts of a vesperaNative publication; consumers add runtimeOnly("<group>:<artifact>:<version>:<platform>"). New vespera.bundleNative (default true) lets an app that takes its library from native jars skip bundleNativeLib. Bridge: when the bundled library is missing, the error names the host platform and the platforms the classpath does bundle (or the other native libraries found), and a failing java.library.path fallback keeps both causes in one UnsatisfiedLinkError. New reusable GitHub Actions template .github/workflow-templates/vespera-native-jars.yml (build matrix -> merge -> nativeJars -> publish).
